ache.title: “Perfect teams” is a moving target
ache.note: The promise here is to make perfect teams in Wuthering Waves 1.1 and prepare for endgame. “Perfect” is the trap: endgame keeps moving, and every new version shows off a team that looks more perfect than yours. Nero kept chasing it. Good enough, and fun, is a real place to stop.
ache.tip: Build one team you enjoy and clear what you can. Content left undone isn’t a debt.
lines: perfect is a word gachas love
endgame isn’t going anywhere. you can, though
good enough is a full win
